kaikki_vikisozluk.u: اللهم صل على محمد وآل محمد
kaikki_vikisozluk.e: ٱللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ • (allāhumma ṣalli ʕalā muḥammadin wa-ʔāli muḥammadin)
g: O God, vouchsafe favor upon Muhammad and Muhammad's family; Salawat, a blessing sent upon the Islamic Prophet Muhammad and his family
r: allāhumma ṣalli ʕalā muḥammadin wa-ʔāli muḥammadin
